core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khamzat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Hamza (Caucasian form)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khamzat corresponds to the Arabic form حَمْزَة (Arabic root ح م ز (ḥ-m-z); حَمْزَة (Ḥamza)). Its core sense is khamzat; hamza (caucasian form). Khamzat is the Chechen form of Arabic حَمْزَة (Ḥamza), a male given name borne by the Prophet's uncle.

persian.name: حمزه
